questions.question: How to book an appointment?
questions.answer_html:
Steps to Book an Appointment via Patient Portal

1

Visit the Patient Portal

Go to the ILS Hospitals website and click on the Patient Portal link.

patient.ilshospitals.com

2

Log in or Register

Existing Users: Enter your registered email ID and password to log in.

New Users: Click Register to create your account by filling in the required details.

3

Select Location

Once logged in, navigate to the Location dropdown section on the dashboard.

4

Choose Department and Doctor

Select a specialty or doctor, check availability, and book a suitable time slot.

5

Confirm Appointment Details

Review your selection, and add any additional notes or requirements.

6

Receive Confirmation

You will receive a booking confirmation on the portal, along with an email or SMS notification.

7

Visit the Hospital

On the appointment day, bring any necessary documents (ID proof, previous medical reports, etc.) and arrive on time.

Book an appointment: online at www.ilshospitals.com or mail your queries to info@ilshospitals.com or call us at:

  • Agartala: 8974050300, 0381 241 5000
  • Dumdum: 033 4031 5000
  • Howrah: 033 4088 0000, 033 4088 1202
  • Salt Lake: 033 4020 6500

standalone_questions.question: Can uterus removal be done via laparoscopy?
standalone_questions.answer_html: Yes, it can be easily and safely removed by laparoscopic surgery. One can go home after 48 hours. No bed rest required after laparoscopic surgery. Can join office in 7 days.
standalone_questions.answer_text: Yes, it can be easily and safely removed by laparoscopic surgery. One can go home after 48 hours. No bed rest required after laparoscopic surgery. Can join office in 7 days.

standalone_questions.question: Do we have to remove uterus for fibroids?
standalone_questions.answer_html: No, it is not done if you want to preserve uterus and want more children. Only if you have completed your family and have more then 2-3 fibroids and nearing menopause then it is better to remove the uterus.

standalone_questions.question: What are the causes of heavy periods in a women over 35 years?
standalone_questions.answer_html: There are numerous cause leading to heavy periods before menopause. It could be due to Fibroids or extra growth of muscles of the uterus (adenomyosis) or due to chocolate cyst ovary where blood accumulates in ovaries. At times the inner lining of the uterus becomes thick leading to heavy bleeding. Need not worry. They can all be treated by micro surgery or laparoscopic surgery now a days. Only 1-2 days hospital stay.

standalone_questions.question: Does PCOD require surgical correction?
standalone_questions.answer_html: No, it does not require surgical correction if it responds to medicines. Only if medicines do not work then laparoscopic drilling may correct this condition.

standalone_questions.question: Long term side effects of PCOD?
standalone_questions.answer_html: If left untreated then one can get diabetes, Endometrial cancer or Breast cancer & heart disease.

standalone_questions.question: Will PCOD result in infertility?
standalone_questions.answer_html: Yes, if it is not reverted, it can lead to infertility. So better control it before you get married. After marriage do not delay pregnancy if you have PCOD. Tell your doctor.
